caption: The drawing depicts a group of people, with a central figure carrying a large, dark brown cross diagonally across his back and shoulders. The central figure is hunched forward and dressed in a long, light brown robe. Surrounding this figure are several men and women. To the left, a woman dressed in a green and dark blue garment covers her mouth with her hand. Beside her and continuing across the scene are four men with various colored garments – including light blue, red, white, and beige – wearing pointed red and gold hats. Two of these men are holding sticks pointed toward the central figure. On the right side of the cross, there are three figures behind the central character, two of whom have halos and wear white and red robes. On the far right, another man in red clothing appears to be holding or guiding the cross. The background is dark brown and black, and the floor below the figures is greenish, with most colors in earthy tones and the clothing in predominantly red, blue, white, and green hues. The drawing has handwritten text at the top and a signature at the bottom right corner.
title: Station of the Cross No. 8: "Jesus Speaks to the Women of Jerusalem"
